NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, do hereby approve the acquisition of two portionsof immovable property, described in the following schedule as it is required by the National Water Supply and DrainageBoard, for the construction of Intake well and pumphouse under Matara Stage IVth Water Supply Project.
RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning and
Water Supply.Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply,No. 35, ‘Lakdiya Medura’,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,01st July, 2016.5/2/1/1173
SCHEDULE

An allotment of land called as Hettigewatta, situated at the village of Malimbada Katuwangoda in the GramaNiladhari Division of Katuwangoda of No. 350A in the Divisonal Secretary’s Division of Malimboda in Matara Disrict andshown as Lot No. 3c and 3d in Plan No. 31 prepared by Mr. Chintharathne Rangodage, Licensed Surveyor and two portionsof land containing in extent of about 0.0846 Hectare (34 perches) acres and bounded as follows :—
1. Lot No. 3c - Extent : 0.0814 hectare (32.20 Perches) only.

North by:Pradeshiya Sabha Road situated in between houses and main road and Lot No. 02 portionof the same land (Plan No. 1410) ;East by:Lot No. 4 portion of the same land (Plan No. 1410) ;South by:Lot No. 4 portion of the same land (Plan No. 1410) ;West by:Lot No. 2 portion of the same land (Plan No. 1410).
